item.title: Forward Momentum On The Rail
item.description: The foundation for the all-around horse is to be a solid mover with correct conformation. The Western Plea-sure and Hunter Under Saddle classes are meant to be used as a launch pad for the other performance classes: Western Riding, Trail, Horsemanship, Hunter Hack, and Jumping, just to name a few.

item.title: Dun Gone Southern wins $7500 Nothin But Nett 5&U Western Riding at 2026 Sun Circuit
item.description: Dun Gone Southern took a unanimous win in the $7500 Added Nothin But Nett 5 & Under Western Riding Stakes at the 2026 Arizona Sun Circuit! Hear from Sara Simons, who piloted “Karl” to the win, and from his owner, Kaleena Weakly, as they reveal more about this exceptional horse!
